Name: NPC_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters for enemy characters.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Picks which attack set this enemy uses. 0 uses its default set.

Fields.Name: Think ID
Fields.Description: Picks this enemy's AI, which decides its attacks and movement. -1 means it has none.

Fields.Name: Name ID
Fields.Description: The name the game shows on this enemy's health bar. Most enemies show no bar, so this stays unused.

Fields.Name: Turn Velocity
Fields.Description: How fast this enemy turns, in degrees per second.

Fields.Name: Simple Collision Height
Fields.Description: How tall this enemy's collision capsule is, in metres. Only used when Use Ragdoll Collision is off.

Fields.Name: Simple Collision Radius
Fields.Description: How wide this enemy's collision capsule is, in metres. Only used when Use Ragdoll Collision is off.

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: How heavy this enemy is, in kilograms. What weight changes in the game is unknown.

Fields.Name: Collision Height Offset
Fields.Description: Lifts this enemy's visible body above its collision, in metres. Set it wrong and hits land where the body is not.

Fields.Name: HP
Fields.Description: Maximum HP. Effects on this enemy and the NG+ bonus can raise it.

Fields.Name: MP
Fields.Description: The magic this enemy can spend on spells. Its exact effect is unknown.

Fields.Name: Item Lot ID: 1
Fields.Description: One item lot this enemy rolls when it dies. -1 rolls nothing.

Fields.Name: Item Lot ID: 2
Fields.Description: One item lot this enemy rolls when it dies. -1 rolls nothing.

Fields.Name: Item Lot ID: 6
Fields.Description: One item lot this enemy rolls when it dies. -1 rolls nothing.

Fields.Name: Humanity Lot ID
Fields.Description: The item lot this enemy rolls for bonus Humanity when it dies. -1 drops none.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 0
Fields.Description: An effect that stays on this enemy at all times. -1 leaves the slot empty.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 1
Fields.Description: An effect that stays on this enemy at all times. -1 leaves the slot empty.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: 7
Fields.Description: An effect that stays on this enemy at all times. -1 leaves the slot empty.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: Game Clear
Fields.Description: A bonus effect that strengthens this enemy on NG+ and later journeys. -1 means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Physical
Fields.Description: How much physical damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent. 100 blocks it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Magic
Fields.Description: How much magic damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent. 100 blocks it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Fire
Fields.Description: How much fire damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent. 100 blocks it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Lightning
Fields.Description: How much lightning damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent. 100 blocks it all.

Fields.Name: Primary Animation ID Offset
Fields.Description: Shifts every animation to a higher set. 10000 moves up one set. Missing animations fall back to the original set.

Fields.Name: Network Warp Judgement Distance
Fields.Description: How far this enemy can move between online updates before it teleports instead of sliding. Raise it for fast enemies.

Fields.Name: Debug Action: R1
Fields.Description: The attack played when this button is pressed in a debug build. It does nothing in the normal game.

Fields.Name: Secondary Animation ID Offset
Fields.Description: Shifts animations to a second set. 10000 moves up one set. Missing animations fall back to the primary set.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Part 1
Fields.Description: Multiplies damage dealt to this body part. 1 leaves damage unchanged. Which body part each number means depends on the model.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Part 2
Fields.Description: Multiplies damage dealt to this body part. 1 leaves damage unchanged. Which body part each number means depends on the model.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Part 3
Fields.Description: Multiplies damage dealt to this body part. 1 leaves damage unchanged. Which body part each number means depends on the model.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Part 4
Fields.Description: Multiplies damage dealt to this body part. 1 leaves damage unchanged. Which body part each number means depends on the model.

Fields.Description: Multiplies damage dealt to this body part. 1 leaves damage unchanged. Which body part each number means depends on the model.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Part 8
Fields.Description: Multiplies damage dealt to this body part. 1 leaves damage unchanged. Which body part each number means depends on the model.

Fields.Name: Damage Multiplier: Weak Point
Fields.Description: Multiplies damage dealt to this enemy's weak point. 1 leaves damage unchanged. Weak hits play a headshot animation when the enemy has one.

Fields.Name: Poise Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: Adjusts how long this enemy waits before its Poise refills. Higher values probably slow recovery.

Fields.Name: Poise Break Stagger Distance
Fields.Description: How far this enemy slides when its Poise breaks, in metres.

Fields.Name: Stamina
Fields.Description: This enemy's stamina pool for blocking. Higher values let it block longer.

Fields.Name: Stamina Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: How fast this enemy regains stamina each second.

Fields.Name: Defense: Physical
Fields.Description: Protection that lowers incoming physical damage. Higher values block more.

Fields.Name: Defense: Slash
Fields.Description: Adds physical defense against slash attacks, as a percent. Negative values weaken it instead.

Fields.Name: Defense: Strike
Fields.Description: Adds physical defense against strike attacks, as a percent. Negative values weaken it instead.

Fields.Name: Defense: Thrust
Fields.Description: Adds physical defense against thrust attacks, as a percent. Negative values weaken it instead.

Fields.Name: Defense: Magic
Fields.Description: Protection that lowers incoming magic damage. Higher values block more.

Fields.Name: Defense: Fire
Fields.Description: Protection that lowers incoming fire damage. Higher values block more.

Fields.Name: Defense: Lightning
Fields.Description: Protection that lowers incoming lightning damage. Higher values block more.

Fields.Name: Repulsion Defense
Fields.Description: How easily attacks bounce off this enemy. Bounced hits lose damage through Repulsion Absorption %.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Poison
Fields.Description: How hard this enemy is to poison. Higher values need more buildup first.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Toxic
Fields.Description: How hard this enemy is to afflict with toxic. Higher values need more buildup first.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Bleed
Fields.Description: How hard this enemy is to bleed. Higher values need more buildup first.

Fields.Name: Status Resist: Curse
Fields.Description: How hard this enemy is to curse. Higher values need more buildup first.

Fields.Name: Wandering Ghost: Model ID
Fields.Description: The replacement model this enemy uses as a wandering ghost.

Fields.Name: Normal Change: Resource ID
Fields.Description: Swaps this enemy's normal model resources. Leave it alone unless a mod needs it.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Guard Angle
Fields.Description: The arc in front of this enemy that its guard covers, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Slash
Fields.Description: How much slash damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent. Negative values increase the damage.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Strike
Fields.Description: How much strike damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent. Negative values increase the damage.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Thrust
Fields.Description: How much thrust damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent. Negative values increase the damage.

Fields.Name: Poise
Fields.Description: How many hits this enemy takes before it staggers. Each hit drains a hidden bar. The bar refills after a few seconds without hits.

Fields.Name: Normal Change: Texture ID
Fields.Description: Swaps this enemy's normal textures. Leave it alone unless a mod needs it.

Fields.Name: Item Drop Type
Fields.Description: Whether this enemy's drops stay on its corpse or fall to the ground.

Fields.Name: Knockback %
Fields.Description: How much knockback this enemy shrugs off, as a percent. 100 stops it fully.

Fields.Name: Knockback ID
Fields.Description: Unknown. The knockback table it points to is unidentified.

Fields.Name: Fall Damage %
Fields.Description: How much fall damage this enemy ignores, as a percent.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Stamina
Fields.Description: How much stamina damage this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Player (Black)
Fields.Description: Black player tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Player (White)
Fields.Description: White player tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Player (Left)
Fields.Description: Left player tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Player (Right)
Fields.Description: Right player tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Area (Black)
Fields.Description: Black area tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Area (White)
Fields.Description: White area tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Area (Left)
Fields.Description: Left area tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: World Tendency: Area (Right)
Fields.Description: Right area tendency this death would shift. Dark Souls has no world tendency, so this likely does nothing.

Fields.Name: MP Recovery Speed
Fields.Description: How fast this enemy regains magic each second, as a percent of its maximum.

Fields.Name: Repulsion Absorption %
Fields.Description: How much damage a bounced hit loses, as a percent. Needs Repulsion Defense to bounce at all.

Fields.Name: Default LOD Param ID
Fields.Description: How this enemy looks from far away. -1 means none.

Fields.Name: Draw Type
Fields.Description: Picks the shader drawn over this enemy, such as a phantom glow.

Fields.Name: Character Type
Fields.Description: Whether this enemy counts as a boss, a mob, or something else.

Fields.Name: Team Type
Fields.Description: Which side this enemy fights on. Test changes in the game.

Fields.Name: Additional Lock-on Distance
Fields.Description: Extra distance added to how far away the player can lock on, in metres.

Fields.Name: Defense Presentation: Sound
Fields.Description: The hit sound this enemy makes when damaged. Match it to what it looks like.

Fields.Name: Defense Presentation: Particle
Fields.Description: The hit particles this enemy shows when damaged. Match them to what it looks like.

Fields.Name: Defense Presentation: Sound (on Weak Point Damage)
Fields.Description: Picks the hit sound for strikes on its weak point.

Fields.Name: Defense Presentation: Particle (on Weak Point Damage)
Fields.Description: Picks the hit particles for strikes on its weak point.

Fields.Name: Parts Damage Type
Fields.Description: Whether the Damage Multiplier fields apply to all attacks or only to projectiles.

Fields.Name: Maximum Angle for Undulation
Fields.Description: How far this enemy can tilt on slopes, in degrees. Needs Is Undulating turned on.

Fields.Name: Guard Damage Level
Fields.Description: How heavy a guard reaction this enemy plays when hit.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Poison
Fields.Description: How much poison buildup this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Toxic
Fields.Description: How much toxic buildup this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Bleed
Fields.Description: How much bleed buildup this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Curse
Fields.Description: How much curse buildup this enemy blocks while guarding, as a percent.

Fields.Name: Parry Attack
Fields.Description: How easily this enemy parries attacks.

Fields.Name: Parry Defense
Fields.Description: How hard this enemy is to parry.

Fields.Name: Camera Push-out Radius
Fields.Description: How far the camera stays from this enemy, in metres.

Fields.Name: Hit Stop Type
Fields.Description: How long hits on this enemy freeze the action.

Fields.Name: Top of Ladder Offset
Fields.Description: Fine-tunes where this enemy gets off ladders at the top, in tenths of a metre.

Fields.Name: Bottom of Ladder Offset
Fields.Description: Fine-tunes where this enemy gets off ladders at the bottom, in tenths of a metre.

Fields.Name: Is Ragdoll Collision valid for Camera Collision
Use Ragdoll Collision
Fields.Description: Lets the player bump into this enemy's whole body. When off, the game uses the simple collision capsule instead.

Fields.Name: Is Demon
Fields.Description: Counts this enemy as a demon. Some weapons deal extra damage to demons.

Fields.Name: Is Ghost
Fields.Description: Makes this enemy a ghost, like the ones in New Londo. Only cursed attackers can harm it. Its attacks pass through shields unless the target is cursed.

Fields.Name: Ignore Damage Motion for Dummy Hits
Fields.Description: Skips the stagger when a hit deals no damage.

Fields.Name: Is Undulating
Fields.Description: Tilts this enemy to match slopes. The tilt caps at Maximum Angle for Undulation.

Fields.Name: Is Valid for Wandering Ghost
Fields.Description: Lets this enemy appear as a wandering ghost while visiting another player's world.

Fields.Name: Enable Head Oscillation
Fields.Description: Lets this enemy turn its head to track targets.

Fields.Name: Disable Bonfire Respawn
Fields.Description: Stops this enemy from returning when the player rests at a bonfire.

Fields.Name: Is Crowd Character
Fields.Description: Uses cheaper updates when many copies crowd together. Meant for swarm enemies.

Fields.Name: Is Weak to Divine
Fields.Description: Counts this enemy as weak to divine. Divine weapons deal extra damage to it.

Fields.Name: Is Weak to Occult
Fields.Description: Counts this enemy as weak to occult. Occult weapons deal extra damage to it.

Fields.Name: Is Abyssal
Fields.Description: Counts this enemy as abyssal, like the Darkwraiths. Some weapons deal extra damage to it.

Fields.Name: Vow Type
Fields.Description: The covenant this enemy belongs to.

Fields.Name: Reload Character on Initialisation
Fields.Description: Brings this enemy back alive when the game reloads, even if bonfires do not respawn it.
